newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - AUG 19.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - AUG 19.

text.p: Here are the main headlines from the noon report of Lithuania's M1 Plus radio station on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Parliament unanimously decided to strip MP Audrius Butkevicius of his parliamentary immunity. He is suspected of taking a $15,000 bribe. Butkevicius denies the accusations.
- The chairman of the German Bundestag's foreign af committee, Karl Heinz Hornhues, supported the aim of Lithuania to start EU entry talks.
